description: 入力挙動改善（高優先度）。現在はEnterで編集モード開始だが、編集確定後のEnterで下のセルへ移動する挙動を追加検討。Excelとの一貫性改善と編集ワークフローの向上が目的。

runs.result_output: The issue was already fully implemented. The "Enter確定後のセル移動" feature exists in `Cell.tsx` — pressing Enter while editing commits the cell value and calls `navigate(rowId, col.key, 1, 0)` to move the cursor down, covering all editable cell types (text input, enum, ref). Both a unit test and an E2E test cover this behavior. I posted a comment with the details and moved the issue to `in_review`.

title: Enter確定後のセル移動
